verdict.rationale: Base44 ships a built-in, managed database as part of the app builder—the Data page shows tables/records directly in-app (base44-docs-9), entities are auto-created and manipulated via SDK CRUD (base44-docs-23, base44-docs-28), and backend/data models sync automatically without leaving the platform. Community corroboration confirms the integrated DB approach is core to the product's value (base44-comm-2). Missing for 10: no independent hands-on walkthrough of provisioning steps, and no detail on schema/migration controls or scaling limits.
